title: SOCI s 30CG SoNS cyber exercise compliance — every Secretary-issued exercise notice has a tracked evaluation report
exclusions: Excludes voluntary internal exercises (these are governed by UC-22.52.21 BC exercise compliance and are not statutory). Excludes exercises that have been formally withdrawn by the Secretary before completion.
evidence: Saved search `UC-22.52.9` archived daily to `audit_evidence` with `soci_clause="SOCI-s30CG"`. Every row pins (sons_asset_id, exercise_notice_id, notice_received_at, exercise_due_at, exercise_completed_at, evaluation_due_at, evaluation_submitted_at, evaluation_artefact_url, exercise_status). Dashboard `SOCI — SoNS Cyber Exercise Tracker` shows every active and historical exercise.

compliance.assurance_rationale: Continuously evidences (a) every Secretary-issued exercise notice is acknowledged, (b) the exercise is run within the notice timeframe, and (c) the evaluation report is submitted within the notice timeframe. This is the full scope of s 30CG.
compliance.controlObjective: Proves the entity complies with every Secretary-issued s 30CG cyber-exercise notice and submits the resulting evaluation report on time.
compliance.evidenceArtifact: Saved search `UC-22.52.9` archived to `audit_evidence`, the `SOCI — SoNS Cyber Exercise Tracker` dashboard, and signed exercise-evaluation-report URLs.

controlTest.positiveScenario: UC-22.52.9 positive (SOCI, 30CG, SoNS, cyber, exercise): ingest synthetic events into `index=target_index` sourcetype='target_sourcetype' where `count` grouped by `entity` satisfies detection threshold for 'SOCI s 30CG SoNS cyber exercise compliance — every Secretary-issued exercise notice has a tracked evaluation report'.  Run the saved search and confirm at least one alertable row.
controlTest.negativeScenario: UC-22.52.9 negative (evaluation report): ingest benign `target_index` / `target_sourcetype` events where `entity` stays below detection threshold, or exclude the test entity via `compliance_exception_register.csv`. Variant 12 confirms zero alert rows for 'SOCI s 30CG SoNS cyber exercise compliance — every Secretary-issued exercise notice has a tracked evaluation report'.

dataSources: SoNS exercise notices, exercise execution events, evaluation submissions. Lookup `sons_exercise_lookup` (sons_asset_id, exercise_notice_id, notice_received_at, exercise_due_at, exercise_completed_at, evaluation_due_at, evaluation_submitted_at, evaluation_artefact_url).
app: Splunk Add-on for ServiceNow (Splunkbase 1928), Splunk Enterprise Security (Splunkbase 263), Splunk Common Information Model Add-on (Splunkbase 1621).
spl:
| inputlookup sons_exercise_lookup
| eval today = now()
| eval exercise_status = case(
    isnotnull(evaluation_submitted_at) AND evaluation_submitted_at <= evaluation_due_at, "compliant",
    isnotnull(evaluation_submitted_at) AND evaluation_submitted_at > evaluation_due_at, "evaluation_overdue_but_submitted",
    isnotnull(exercise_completed_at) AND today > evaluation_due_at, "evaluation_overdue",
    isnotnull(exercise_completed_at) AND today <= evaluation_due_at, "evaluation_pending",
    today > exercise_due_at, "exercise_overdue",
    1=1, "exercise_scheduled")
| eval days_to_exercise_due = round((exercise_due_at - today) / 86400, 0)
| eval days_to_evaluation_due = round((evaluation_due_at - today) / 86400, 0)
| table sons_asset_id exercise_notice_id notice_received_at exercise_due_at exercise_completed_at evaluation_due_at evaluation_submitted_at evaluation_artefact_url exercise_status days_to_exercise_due days_to_evaluation_due
description: Identifies UC-22.52.9 — SOCI, 30CG, SoNS, cyber, exercise — using `index=target_index` sourcetype `configured sourcetype`, grouped by `entity`. Outputs `count` each `the scheduled window`; alert when configured threshold. Primary focus: evaluation report. Purpose-built for 'SOCI s 30CG SoNS cyber exercise compliance — every Secretary-issued exercise notice has a tracked evaluation report' in Compliance workflows.
value: Tracking `activity` via UC-22.52.9 on UC-22.52.9 search results improves response to 'SOCI s 30CG SoNS cyber exercise compliance — every Secretary-issued exercise notice has a tracked evaluation report' and reduces audit findings, regulatory gaps, and attestation delays.
implementation: (1) The SoNS Programme Lead registers every Secretary notice in `sons_exercise_lookup` on receipt; updates `exercise_completed_at` on exercise close-out; updates `evaluation_submitted_at` when the report is filed. (2) Schedule UC-22.52.9 daily; route `exercise_overdue` / `evaluation_overdue` to notable severity=high.
visualization: (Panel 1) Active exercises kanban: scheduled / in-flight / pending-evaluation / overdue. (Panel 2) Historical compliance table. (Panel 3) Mean exercise-to-evaluation lead time. (Panel 4) Exercise frequency by SoNS.

references.title: Security of Critical Infrastructure Act 2018 (Cth) — s 30CG cyber-security exercise on demand

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Authorised SOCI control testing** — Internal audit exercises 'SOCI s 30CG SoNS cyber exercise compliance — every Secretary-issued exercise notice has a tracked evaluation report' (UC-22.52.9) on `entity` during scheduled clause SOCI-s30CG sampling. Match compliance programme calendar.

2. **External assessor sampling** — QSA activity spikes `index=audit_evidence` `configured sourcetype` without crossing evidence threshold. Cross-check engagement letter in `soci_exception_register.csv`.

3. **Planned maintenance affecting control telemetry** — CAB change pauses ingestion to `audit_evidence` for `entity`. Compare `_time` with active change record.

4. **Third-party processor under contract** — BAA/DPA-covered vendor generates expected rows grouped by `entity` during normal service delivery.

**Suppression mechanism:** `soci_exception_register.csv` keyed on `entity`, `exception_reason`, `valid_until`, joined before alert threshold.
mitreAttack: N/A (governance and statutory-exercise workflow — measures compliance with Secretary notices, not adversary detection)
detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

- Splunk Enterprise ≥9.2 or Splunk Cloud.
- ES, Splunk Add-on for ServiceNow.
- `index=audit_evidence`.
- Lookup `sons_exercise_lookup` — owned by SoNS Programme Lead. Columns: `sons_asset_id`, `exercise_notice_id`, `notice_received_at` (epoch), `exercise_due_at` (epoch), `exercise_completed_at` (epoch), `evaluation_due_at` (epoch), `evaluation_submitted_at` (epoch), `evaluation_artefact_url`.

## Step 1 — Configure data collection

The lookup is the contract; the SoNS Programme Lead is responsible for keeping it accurate. Best practice: integrate the lookup with the GRC system so notice-receipt and evaluation-submission are tracked in the same place. A nightly summary materialises the lookup from the GRC:

```spl
index=grc sourcetype=snow:sons_exercise earliest=-7d@d
| dedup exercise_notice_id sortby - _time
| table sons_asset_id exercise_notice_id notice_received_at exercise_due_at exercise_completed_at evaluation_due_at evaluation_submitted_at evaluation_artefact_url
| outputlookup sons_exercise_lookup
```

## Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule:

```ini
[UC-22.52.9: SOCI s 30CG SoNS cyber exercise compliance]
cron_schedule = 0 7 * * *
dispatch.earliest_time = -1d@d
dispatch.latest_time = now
actions = summary_index, notable
action.summary_index._name = audit_evidence
action.summary_index.marker = uc=22.52.9,reg=SOCI,clause=SOCI-s30CG
action.notable.param.rule_title = SOCI s 30CG SoNS exercise compliance gap
action.notable.param.security_domain = audit
action.notable.param.severity = high
alert.severity = 4
```

Notable on `exercise_status IN (exercise_overdue, evaluation_overdue)`; archive every row.

## Step 3 — Validate deployment

**(a)** Positive control: insert an exercise with past `exercise_due_at` and no completion; UC flags `exercise_overdue`.

**(b)** Negative control: complete the exercise and submit evaluation before due; UC records `compliant`.

**(c)** Annual ASD post-exercise debrief: validate that the evaluation reports filed match ASD's expectations.

## Step 4 — Operationalize

**Dashboard**: `SOCI — SoNS Cyber Exercise Tracker`.

**Runbook for `exercise_overdue`** (owner: SoNS Programme Lead, severity P1):

1. Within 1 business day: contact the ASD exercise coordinator; explain the delay and agree a revised date.
2. Self-disclose in next Rule 10 annual report.

**Runbook for `evaluation_overdue`** (owner: SoNS Programme Lead, severity P2):

1. Within 5 business days: submit the evaluation report.
2. Self-disclose.

## Step 5 — Troubleshooting

**Lookup empty** — the SoNS Programme Lead has not registered notices. Confirm process.

**Wrong dates** — epoch conversion bug.

**SOCI-specific failure modes**:

- **Joint exercises across multiple SoNS**: a single exercise notice may cover multiple SoNS; lookup must support mvfield of `sons_asset_id`.
- **Re-scheduled exercises**: if the Secretary agrees a re-scheduled date, update both `exercise_due_at` and `evaluation_due_at`; preserve original dates in `audit_evidence` audit-trail.
- **Exercise findings flow back to CIRMP**: a finding from a s 30CG exercise may flag a material risk that has to be added to the CIRMP under UC-22.52.12. Ensure the exercise debrief includes a CIRMP-update trigger.

Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Splunk Add-on for ServiceNow (Splunkbase 1928), Splunk Enterprise Security (Splunkbase 263), Splunk Common Information Model Add-on (Splunkbase 1621).). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=see SPL into index=main. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`exercise_status`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: When the government formally asks us to run a cyber-attack practice on one of our most important systems, we must do the practice on time and send a report. We track every official practice from the moment the notice arrives until the report is filed, and we ring the bell if any step slips.
